test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following special trains can be taken to travel to Lumbini, Bodhgaya, Sarnath and Kushinagar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhist Circuit Tourist Train.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Buddhist circuit tourist train is the train recently started by the Indian Railways.
 
• It travels to Lumbini, Bodhgaya, Sarnath and Kushinagar.
 
• It links all the places associated with Budhha and Buddhism.
 
• The new chairman of the Railway board is **Vinay Kumar Tripathi (1 Jan 2022–30 Jun 2022).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Important Tourist trains:**
 
• **Vaishnodevi with Amritsar, Ex Silchar **
 
 
• Destination: AMRITSAR / VAISHNO DEVI
 
 
 
• **07 Jyotirlinga Yatra **
 
 
• Destination: BHIMSHANKAR / DWARKADHISH / GRISHNESHWAR / MAHAKALESHWAR / NAGESHWAR / OMKARESHWAR / PARLI VAIJANATH / SABARMATI JN / SOMNATH / STATUE OF UNITY / TRIAMBAKESHWAR
 
 
 
• **Banglore Mysore with Dakshin Darshan Yatra**
 
 
• Destination: BANGALORE / KANYAKUMARI / MADURAI / MYSORE / RAMESHWARAM / TIRUCHIRAPALLI / TIRUPATI / TRIVANDRUM
 
 
 
• **Uttar Bharat Darshan With Mata Vaishno Devi **
 
 
• Destination: AGRA / AMRITSAR / HARIDWAR / Mathura / VAISHNO DEVI
 
 
 
• **Dakshin Bharat Tourist Trai**
 
 
• Destination: Ayodhya / Haridwar / Mathura / Prayagraj / Rishikesh / Varanasi / Vrindavan
 
 
 
• **Vaishnodevi with Uttar Bharat Darshan **
 
 
• Destination: Ayodhya / Haridwar / Shivkhori / Vaishno Devi / Varanasi
